[SWS_CM_00061] Mapping of Unsubscribe Service in case of Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding
⌈
If instructed to un-subscribe from an event which is part of a RequiredUserDe-
finedServiceInstance of category SIGNALBASED_IEEE1722_ACF, then the
Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding shall check:
• If this is the last communication which uses the respective socket, then this socket
shall be closed.
• If there is still other communication using this socket, then the socket shall be
kept open.
⌋
